# Database schema reference

<!-- Generated by db/tools/generate_schema_docs.py from the database catalogue. Do not edit. -->

Migration head: `20260924_0008`. Design notes: [README.md](README.md). Diagram: [ERD.md](ERD.md).

## Schemas

| Schema | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ref` | National reference geodata (admin boundaries, settlements, roads, protected areas). Read-only at runtime. |
| `ops` | Tenant-owned operational geodata (sites, devices, geofences). Protected by row-level security. |
| `geo` | Event locations and geo-context enrichment results. |
| `meta` | Layer registry, reference data releases, lineage and database helper functions. |
| `audit` | Append-only audit records for spatial searches, geofence changes and data releases. |

## Tables

| Table | Purpose | RLS | Partitioned |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`ref.admin_area`](#refadmin-area) | Administrative areas of Sri Lanka: level 0 country, 1 province, 2 district, 3 divisional secretariat (DS) division, 4 Grama Niladhari (GN) division. |  |  |
| [`ref.area_part`](#refarea-part) | Polygons of the area layers split with ST_Subdivide (at most 255 vertices each), so that point-in-polygon tests touch small geometries. Maintained by triggers; do not write directly. |  |  |
| [`ref.facility`](#reffacility) | Public facilities used as geographic context (police stations, hospitals, wildlife offices, ...). |  |  |
| [`ref.protected_area`](#refprotected-area) | Protected areas: national parks, sanctuaries, nature reserves, forest reserves. |  |  |
| [`ref.risk_zone`](#refrisk-zone) | Hazard and risk zones (elephant corridors, flood, landslide, ...) with severity and validity. |  |  |
| [`ref.road`](#refroad) | Road network. road_class follows the RDA classification (E expressways, A/B national, C/D provincial) plus local roads and tracks. |  |  |
| [`ref.settlement`](#refsettlement) | Populated places. A settlement is a point (place node) or a footprint polygon; nearest-settlement distances are measured to the footprint edge (0 inside). |  |  |
| [`ref.water_body`](#refwater-body) | Rivers, streams and canals (lines); reservoirs, tanks, lakes, lagoons and wetlands (polygons). |  |  |
| [`ops.device`](#opsdevice) | Cameras and sensors owned by a tenant, optionally installed at a site. | yes |  |
| [`ops.device_field_of_view`](#opsdevice-field-of-view) | Area a camera or sensor observes, per validity period (no overlapping periods per device). Modelled sectors are computed by the database from the device position. | yes |  |
| [`ops.geofence`](#opsgeofence) | Tenant geofences: polygons, circles (point + radius) and corridors (line + half-width). Search geometries are derived by the database. | yes |  |
| [`ops.site`](#opssite) | Installation sites (poles, buildings, checkpoints) owned by a tenant. | yes |  |
| [`geo.event_geo_context`](#geoevent-geo-context) | Geographic context of an event, computed against one reference data release. The full result is in document (schema geo-context/1); frequently filtered values are also columns. | yes | `RANGE (observed_at)` |
| [`geo.event_geofence_hit`](#geoevent-geofence-hit) | Geofences an event lies in, as a snapshot: the hit keeps the geofence id, owner and version even if the geofence is later changed or deleted. No foreign key, so a hit never pins a geofence that another tenant shared. | yes | `RANGE (observed_at)` |
| [`geo.event_location`](#geoevent-location) | Observed location of an event (point, line or area), partitioned by month of observed_at (UTC). | yes | `RANGE (observed_at)` |
| [`geo.event_zone_hit`](#geoevent-zone-hit) | Protected areas and risk zones an event lies in (within) or overlaps (intersects). | yes | `RANGE (observed_at)` |
| [`meta.data_source`](#metadata-source) | Publisher and licence of a reference dataset. A source whose licence does not allow commercial use can only be registered with the reference of a written permission. |  |  |
| [`meta.dataset_load`](#metadataset-load) | Lineage of reference data: one row per source file loaded into a release, with checksum, source CRS, transformation and counts. Deleting a load deletes the features it loaded. |  |  |
| [`meta.geometry_repair`](#metageometry-repair) | Reference geometries repaired on load: the reason reported by ST_IsValidReason, the original geometry and the area before and after repair (EPSG:5235). |  |  |
| [`meta.layer`](#metalayer) | Registry of spatial layers: table, geometry types, CRS, tenancy and update pattern. Rows are maintained by the migration that creates the layer table. |  |  |
| [`meta.qa_finding`](#metaqa-finding) | A problem found by a QA run: check, severity (error blocks publication), layer, feature and location. Only the waiver columns can change, and only while the release is a draft. |  |  |
| [`meta.qa_run`](#metaqa-run) | One run of the reference data QA checks: on a pipeline output file (stage file, per dataset load) or on the loaded release (stage database). A release is published only after a database run that saw its final content and left no unwaived errors. |  |  |
| [`meta.ref_data_release`](#metaref-data-release) | Versioned reference data release (ref-YYYY.MM). Rows are loaded into a draft; a published release is immutable. Exactly one published release is current. |  |  |
| [`meta.release_artifact`](#metarelease-artifact) | Files built for a reference data release that are not tables: the basemap tiles (PMTiles), its MapLibre style and glyphs. Served as static files; recorded here with checksum, CRS, zoom range and bounds so the release describes everything a client shows. |  |  |
| [`meta.release_artifact_source`](#metarelease-artifact-source) | Sources an artifact was built from, with the licence as it was when the artifact was built. |  |  |
| [`meta.tenant`](#metatenant) | Organisations and authorities that own operational geodata and events. Provisioned by an administrator; read-only for the API. |  |  |
| [`audit.entry`](#auditentry) | Append-only audit log: searches, sensitive queries and exports (recorded by the API in the transaction that answers them) and changes to geofences, sites, devices and reference data releases (recorded by triggers). Who, when and for which tenant is stamped by the database. | yes |  |

## Schema `ref`

<a id="refadmin-area"></a>

### `ref.admin_area`

Administrative areas of Sri Lanka: level 0 country, 1 province, 2 district, 3 divisional secretariat (DS) division, 4 Grama Niladhari (GN) division.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` |  | `uuidv7()` |  |
| `release_id` | `uuid` |  |  | Reference data release this row belongs to. |
| `load_id` | `uuid` |  |  | Dataset load (lineage) that produced this row. |
| `source_feature_id` | `text` | yes |  | Identifier of the feature in the source dataset. |
| `name` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `name_si` | `text` | yes |  | Name in Sinhala. |
| `name_ta` | `text` | yes |  | Name in Tamil. |
| `level` | `smallint` |  |  | 0 country, 1 province, 2 district, 3 DS division, 4 GN division. |
| `level_name` | `text` | yes | generated: `CASE level WHEN 0 THEN 'country'::text WHEN 1 THEN 'province'::text WHEN 2 THEN 'district'::text WHEN 3 THEN 'ds_division'::text WHEN 4 THEN 'gn_division'::text ELSE NULL::text END` |  |
| `code` | `text` |  |  | Official or P-code of the area, unique per level within a release. |
| `parent_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Containing area one level up, in the same release. Optional for provinces. |
| `geom` | `geometry(MultiPolygon,4326)` |  |  | Canonical geometry, EPSG:4326 (longitude, latitude). |
| `geom_metric` | `geometry(MultiPolygon,5235)` | yes | generated: `st_transform(geom, 5235)` | Stored EPSG:5235 (SLD99 / Sri Lanka Grid 1999) copy of geom for metric operations. |
| `geometry_source` | `text` |  | `'unknown'::text` | How the geometry was captured: survey, gps, digitised, imagery, osm, derived, synthetic, unknown. |
| `geometry_accuracy_m` | `numeric(10,2)` | yes |  | Estimated horizontal accuracy of the geometry in metres. |
| `attributes` | `jsonb` |  | `'{}'::jsonb` | Additional source attributes (JSON object). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |

**Constraints**

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `pk_admin_area` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
| `fk_admin_area_load_id_release_id_dataset_load` | foreign key | `FOREIGN KEY (load_id, release_id) REFERENCES meta.dataset_load(id, release_id) ON DELETE CASCADE` |
| `fk_admin_area_parent_id_release_id_admin_area` | foreign key | `FOREIGN KEY (parent_id, release_id) REFERENCES ref.admin_area(id, release_id)` |
| `uq_admin_area_id_release_id` | unique | `UNIQUE (id, release_id)` |
| `uq_admin_area_release_id_level_code` | unique | `UNIQUE (release_id, level, code)` |
| `uq_admin_area_release_id_source_feature_id` | unique | `UNIQUE (release_id, source_feature_id)` |
| `ck_admin_area_attributes_is_object` | check | `CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(attributes) = 'object'::text))` |
| `ck_admin_area_code_not_blank` | check | `CHECK ((btrim(code) <> ''::text))` |
| `ck_admin_area_country_has_no_parent` | check | `CHECK (((level > 0) OR (parent_id IS NULL)))` |
| `ck_admin_area_geom_in_service_area` | check | `CHECK (meta.is_within_sri_lanka(geom))` |
| `ck_admin_area_geom_not_empty` | check | `CHECK ((NOT st_isempty(geom)))` |
| `ck_admin_area_geom_valid` | check | `CHECK (st_isvalid(geom, 0))` |
| `ck_admin_area_geometry_accuracy_m` | check | `CHECK ((geometry_accuracy_m > (0)::numeric))` |
| `ck_admin_area_geometry_source` | check | `CHECK ((geometry_source = ANY (ARRAY['survey'::text, 'gps'::text, 'digitised'::text, 'imagery'::text, 'osm'::text, 'derived'::text, 'synthetic'::text, 'unknown'::text])))` |
| `ck_admin_area_level` | check | `CHECK (((level >= 0) AND (level <= 4)))` |
| `ck_admin_area_name_not_blank` | check | `CHECK ((btrim(name) <> ''::text))` |
| `ck_admin_area_parent_required` | check | `CHECK (((level <= 1) OR (parent_id IS NOT NULL)))` |

**Indexes**

| Name | Method | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `ix_admin_area_load_id` | btree | `btree (load_id)` |
| `ix_admin_area_parent_id` | btree | `btree (parent_id)` |
| `ix_admin_area_release_id_geom_gist` | gist | `gist (release_id, geom)` |
| `ix_admin_area_release_id_geom_metric_gist` | gist | `gist (release_id, geom_metric)` |

**Triggers** (fire in name order)

| Name | Fires | Condition | Executes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a10_guard_release_is_draft` | BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE (per row) |  | `meta.guard_release_is_draft()` |
| `a20_normalise_geometry` | BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF geom (per row) |  | `meta.normalise_reference_geometry()` |
| `a30_check_parent` | BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF parent_id, level, release_id (per row) |  | `ref.check_admin_area_parent()` |
| `a90_touch_updated_at` | BEFORE UPDATE (per row) |  | `meta.touch_updated_at()` |
| `z10_sync_area_part` | AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF geom, release_id (per row) |  | `ref.sync_area_part('admin_area')` |

<a id="refarea-part"></a>

### `ref.area_part`

Polygons of the area layers split with ST_Subdivide (at most 255 vertices each), so that point-in-polygon tests touch small geometries. Maintained by triggers; do not write directly.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `bigint` |  | identity |  |
| `release_id` | `uuid` |  |  |  |
| `area_kind` | `text` |  |  | Source table: admin_area, protected_area, risk_zone, water_body. |
| `feature_id` | `uuid` |  |  | id of the source row in ref.<area_kind>. |
| `geom` | `geometry(Polygon,4326)` |  |  | Part of the source geometry, EPSG:4326 (containment is evaluated in the canonical CRS). |

**Constraints**

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `pk_area_part` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
| `ck_area_part_area_kind` | check | `CHECK ((area_kind = ANY (ARRAY['admin_area'::text, 'protected_area'::text, 'risk_zone'::text, 'water_body'::text])))` |

**Indexes**

| Name | Method | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `ix_area_part_feature_id` | btree | `btree (feature_id)` |
| `ix_area_part_release_id_area_kind_geom_gist` | gist | `gist (release_id, area_kind, geom)` |

Cameras and sensors owned by a tenant, optionally installed at a site.

### `ops.device_field_of_view`

Area a camera or sensor observes, per validity period (no overlapping periods per device). Modelled sectors are computed by the database from the device position.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `fov_deg` | `numeric(5,2)` | yes |  | Horizontal field-of-view angle in degrees (360 for omnidirectional sensors). |

| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |

### `ops.geofence`

Tenant geofences: polygons, circles (point + radius) and corridors (line + half-width). Search geometries are derived by the database.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` |  | `uuidv7()` |  |
| `tenant_id` | `text` |  | `meta.current_tenant_id()` | Owning tenant. Defaults to the tenant of the current transaction. |
| `sharing_policy` | `text` |  | `'private'::text` | private (owner only), shared (owner, listed tenants and authorities) or authority_only (owner and authorities). |
| `shared_with_tenants` | `text[]` |  | `'{}'::text[]` | Tenants that may read the row when sharing_policy = 'shared'. |
| `external_id` | `text` | yes |  | Identifier of the geofence in the tenant's own systems. |
| `name` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `description` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `geofence_kind` | `text` |  |  | polygon, circle or corridor. |
| `definition_geom` | `geometry(Geometry,4326)` |  |  | Geometry as defined by the user, EPSG:4326: polygon, circle centre or corridor centre line. |
| `definition_geom_metric` | `geometry(Geometry,5235)` | yes | generated: `st_transform(definition_geom, 5235)` | Stored EPSG:5235 copy of definition_geom; circle and corridor hits are ST_DWithin(definition_geom_metric, point, radius_m), boundary inclusive. |
| `radius_m` | `numeric(10,2)` | yes |  | Circle radius or corridor half-width in metres. |
| `geom` | `geometry(MultiPolygon,4326)` |  |  | Area as an EPSG:4326 MultiPolygon (display, bounding-box search). |
| `geom_metric` | `geometry(MultiPolygon,5235)` |  |  | Search area in EPSG:5235. For circles and corridors it circumscribes the exact buffer (quad_segs=32); for polygons it is the transformed definition. |
| `area_m2` | `double precision` |  |  | Area in square metres (exact for circles). |
| `status` | `text` |  | `'active'::text` | draft, active, suspended or archived. Only active geofences produce hits. |
| `effective_during` | `tstzrange` |  | `tstzrange(now(), NULL::timestamp with time zone)` | Period in which the geofence produces hits. |
| `attributes` | `jsonb` |  | `'{}'::jsonb` |  |
| `version` | `integer` |  | `1` | Row version, incremented on every update (optimistic concurrency). |
| `created_by` | `text` | yes |  | Identity of the user or client that created the row, as supplied by the API. |
| `updated_by` | `text` | yes |  | Identity of the user or client that last changed the row, as supplied by the API. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |

## Schema `geo`

<a id="geoevent-geo-context"></a>

### `geo.event_geo_context`

Geographic context of an event, computed against one reference data release. The full result is in document (schema geo-context/1); frequently filtered values are also columns.

Partitioned by `RANGE (observed_at)`; monthly partitions `event_geo_context_pYYYYMM` are created by `geo.ensure_event_partition()`.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenant_id` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `event_id` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `observed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  |  |  |
| `schema_version` | `text` |  | `'geo-context/1'::text` | Version of the geo-context document schema. |
| `release_id` | `uuid` |  |  | Reference data release the context was computed against. |
| `release_code` | `text` |  |  | Code of that release (ref-YYYY.MM). |
| `computed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` | When the context was computed. |
| `location_source` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `admin_l1_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Province containing the event (ref.admin_area, level 1). |
| `admin_l1_code` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `admin_l2_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | District containing the event (level 2). |
| `admin_l2_code` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `admin_l3_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | DS division containing the event (level 3). |
| `admin_l3_code` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `admin_l4_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | GN division containing the event (level 4). |
| `admin_l4_code` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `nearest_settlement_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `nearest_settlement_distance_m` | `numeric(12,2)` | yes |  | Distance to the nearest settlement in metres (EPSG:5235). |
| `nearest_road_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `nearest_road_distance_m` | `numeric(12,2)` | yes |  | Distance to the nearest road in metres (EPSG:5235). |
| `document` | `jsonb` |  |  | Complete geo-context as returned by the API (camelCase JSON). |

**Constraints**

|---|---|---|

<a id="geoevent-geofence-hit"></a>

### `geo.event_geofence_hit`

Geofences an event lies in, as a snapshot: the hit keeps the geofence id, owner and version even if the geofence is later changed or deleted. No foreign key, so a hit never pins a geofence that another tenant shared.

Partitioned by `RANGE (observed_at)`; monthly partitions `event_geofence_hit_pYYYYMM` are created by `geo.ensure_event_partition()`.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenant_id` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `event_id` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `observed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  |  |  |
| `geofence_id` | `uuid` |  |  | id of the ops.geofence row at computation time. |
| `geofence_tenant_id` | `text` |  |  | Owner of the geofence (may differ from tenant_id for shared geofences). |
| `geofence_version` | `integer` |  |  | Version of the geofence the hit was computed against. |
| `relation` | `text` |  |  | within: the whole event lies in the geofence (for circles and corridors: inside the buffer of radius_m drawn with 32 segments per quarter circle; a point hit is always within); intersects: only part of it does. |

**Constraints**

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `pk_event_geofence_hit` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, event_id, observed_at, geofence_id)` |
| `fk_event_geofence_hit_tenant_id_event_id_observed_at_event_geo_` | foreign key | `FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, event_id, observed_at) REFERENCES geo.event_geo_context(tenant_id, event_id, observed_at) ON DELETE CASCADE` |
| `ck_event_geofence_hit_geofence_version` | check | `CHECK ((geofence_version >= 1))` |
| `ck_event_geofence_hit_relation` | check | `CHECK ((relation = ANY (ARRAY['within'::text, 'intersects'::text])))` |

**Indexes**

| Name | Method | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `ix_event_geofence_hit_geofence_id_observed_at` | btree | `btree (geofence_id, observed_at)` |

**Row-level security policies**

| Policy | Command | USING | WITH CHECK |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_geofence_hit_delete` | DELETE | `(tenant_id = meta.current_tenant_id())` |  |

| `event_geofence_hit_update` | UPDATE | `(tenant_id = meta.current_tenant_id())` | `(tenant_id = meta.current_tenant_id())` |

<a id="geoevent-location"></a>

### `geo.event_location`

Observed location of an event (point, line or area), partitioned by month of observed_at (UTC).

Partitioned by `RANGE (observed_at)`; monthly partitions `event_location_pYYYYMM` are created by `geo.ensure_event_partition()`.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenant_id` | `text` |  | `meta.current_tenant_id()` | Tenant that owns the event. |
| `event_id` | `text` |  |  | Event identifier assigned by the event platform. |
| `observed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  |  | When the event was observed. Partition key. |
| `event_type` | `text` |  |  | Dotted lower-case event type, e.g. wildlife.elephant_detected. |
| `event_subtype` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `source_type` | `text` |  |  | device, sensor, external or manual. |
| `device_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Device that observed the event (same tenant). |
| `source_ref` | `text` | yes |  | Identifier of the source in an external system. |
| `location_source` | `text` |  |  | device (installed position of the device), estimated (computed, e.g. triangulated), sensor (position reported by the sensor, e.g. GNSS) or external. |
| `geom` | `geometry(Geometry,4326)` |  |  | Event geometry, EPSG:4326: point, line or area. |
| `geom_metric` | `geometry(Geometry,5235)` | yes | generated: `st_transform(geom, 5235)` | Stored EPSG:5235 copy of geom. |
| `geometry_kind` | `text` | yes | generated: `CASE st_dimension(geom) WHEN 0 THEN 'point'::text WHEN 1 THEN 'line'::text ELSE 'area'::text END` | point, line or area, from the dimension of geom. |
| `location_accuracy_m` | `numeric(10,2)` | yes |  | Estimated horizontal accuracy of the location in metres. |
| `field_of_view_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Device field of view in effect when the event was observed. |
| `field_of_view` | `geometry(MultiPolygon,4326)` | yes |  | Snapshot of the field-of-view area at observation time, EPSG:4326. |
| `attributes` | `jsonb` |  | `'{}'::jsonb` | Additional GIS-relevant event metadata (JSON object). |
| `received_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` | When the GIS service stored the event location. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |

## Schema `meta`

<a id="metadata-source"></a>

### `meta.data_source`

Publisher and licence of a reference dataset. A source whose licence does not allow commercial use can only be registered with the reference of a written permission.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` |  | `uuidv7()` |  |
| `code` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `name` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `publisher` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `url` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `licence` | `text` |  |  | Licence identifier, SPDX where one exists (ODbL-1.0, CC-BY-3.0-IGO, ...). |
| `licence_url` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `attribution` | `text` |  |  | Attribution text that must accompany maps and exports using this source. |
| `commercial_use_allowed` | `boolean` |  |  | Whether the licence itself permits use in a commercial service. |
| `share_alike` | `boolean` |  | `false` |  |
| `permission_reference` | `text` | yes |  | Agreement or letter granting use when the licence does not. |
| `notes` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |
| `redistribution_allowed` | `boolean` |  |  | Whether the licence lets the data leave the platform (exports, downloads). False blocks exports of layers built from it. |
| `licence_review_status` | `text` |  | `'unreviewed'::text` | unreviewed, approved or rejected. Production releases need approved licences; nothing is assumed. |
| `licence_reviewed_by` | `text` | yes |  | Who reviewed the licence for the intended deployment. |
| `licence_reviewed_on` | `date` | yes |  | When the review was recorded. |
| `licence_review_reference` | `text` | yes |  | Legal memo, ticket or agreement the review refers to. |

**Constraints**

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `pk_data_source` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
| `uq_data_source_code` | unique | `UNIQUE (code)` |

| `ck_data_source_code_format` | check | `CHECK ((code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{1,62}$'::text))` |

| `ck_data_source_licence_review_status` | check | `CHECK ((licence_review_status = ANY (ARRAY['unreviewed'::text, 'approved'::text, 'rejected'::text])))` |

<a id="metatenant"></a>

### `meta.tenant`

Organisations and authorities that own operational geodata and events. Provisioned by an administrator; read-only for the API.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenant_id` | `text` |  |  | Stable identifier used in gis.tenant_id and every tenant_id column. |
| `name` | `text` |  |  |  |
| `kind` | `text` |  | `'organisation'::text` | organisation, or authority (may read rows shared with authorities). |
| `is_active` | `boolean` |  | `true` |  |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  | `now()` |  |

**Constraints**

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `pk_tenant` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id)` |
| `ck_tenant_kind` | check | `CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['organisation'::text, 'authority'::text])))` |
| `ck_tenant_name_not_blank` | check | `CHECK ((btrim(name) <> ''::text))` |
| `ck_tenant_tenant_id_format` | check | `CHECK ((tenant_id ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,62}$'::text))` |

**Triggers** (fire in name order)

| Name | Fires | Condition | Executes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a90_touch_updated_at` | BEFORE UPDATE (per row) |  | `meta.touch_updated_at()` |

## Schema `audit`

<a id="auditentry"></a>

### `audit.entry`

Append-only audit log: searches, sensitive queries and exports (recorded by the API in the transaction that answers them) and changes to geofences, sites, devices and reference data releases (recorded by triggers). Who, when and for which tenant is stamped by the database.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `bigint` |  | identity |  |
| `occurred_at` | `timestamp with time zone` |  |  | When the operation ran (clock time, stamped by the database). |
| `tenant_id` | `text` | yes |  | Tenant the operation acted for: the transaction's tenant, stamped by the database; for a change made without one (directly in the database), the changed row's tenant. NULL for reference data releases and requests acting for no tenant. |
| `category` | `text` |  |  | search, sensitive_query (a read of tenant operational data or events), export, change (geofence, site, device) or release (reference data). |
| `operation` | `text` |  |  | What was done, e.g. query.within_distance, events.list, geofence.archive, reference_release.publish. |
| `target` | `text` | yes |  | Layer or table the operation read or changed. |
| `object_id` | `text` | yes |  | Identifier of the object changed or read, when there is one. |
| `actor_subject` | `text` |  |  | Opaque subject id of the caller from the identity provider (never a name or e-mail address); the database login when no caller context was set. |
| `actor_client` | `text` | yes |  | OAuth client the caller used (azp). |
| `actor_roles` | `text[]` |  |  | GIS roles the caller held. |
| `cross_tenant` | `boolean` |  |  | True when a platform role or service acted for a tenant that is not its own. |
| `channel` | `text` |  |  | api, loader (reference data tool) or database (a login changing rows directly). |
| `request_id` | `text` | yes |  | Request id of the API call (also in the access log). |
| `db_user` | `text` |  |  | Database login that wrote the entry. |
| `geometry_type` | `text` | yes |  | Type of the geometry searched with or changed. |
| `geometry_extent` | `geometry(Polygon,4326)` | yes |  | Bounding box of that geometry widened to a 0.001 degree grid (about 110 m). The geometry itself is not kept. |
| `parameters` | `jsonb` |  | `'{}'::jsonb` | Filters, distances, windows and other parameters of the operation. |
| `result_count` | `integer` | yes |  | Number of results returned (reads, exports) or features published (releases). |

**Constraints**

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `pk_entry` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
| `ck_entry_actor_subject_not_blank` | check | `CHECK ((btrim(actor_subject) <> ''::text))` |
| `ck_entry_category` | check | `CHECK ((category = ANY (ARRAY['search'::text, 'sensitive_query'::text, 'export'::text, 'change'::text, 'release'::text])))` |
| `ck_entry_channel` | check | `CHECK ((channel = ANY (ARRAY['api'::text, 'loader'::text, 'database'::text])))` |
| `ck_entry_cross_tenant_names_tenant` | check | `CHECK (((NOT cross_tenant) OR (tenant_id IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `ck_entry_geometry_extent_valid` | check | `CHECK (st_isvalid(geometry_extent, 0))` |
| `ck_entry_operation_format` | check | `CHECK ((operation ~ '^[a-z][a-z_]*([.][a-z][a-z_]*)+$'::text))` |
| `ck_entry_parameters_is_object` | check | `CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(parameters) = 'object'::text))` |
| `ck_entry_result_count` | check | `CHECK ((result_count >= 0))` |
| `ck_entry_tenant_id_format` | check | `CHECK ((tenant_id ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,62}$'::text))` |

**Indexes**

| Name | Method | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `ix_entry_actor_subject_occurred_at` | btree | `btree (actor_subject, occurred_at)` |
| `ix_entry_geometry_extent_gist` | gist | `gist (geometry_extent)` |
| `ix_entry_occurred_at_brin` | brin | `brin (occurred_at)` |
| `ix_entry_tenant_id_occurred_at_id` | btree | `btree (tenant_id, occurred_at, id)` |

**Triggers** (fire in name order)

| Name | Fires | Condition | Executes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a10_stamp_entry` | BEFORE INSERT (per row) |  | `audit.stamp_entry()` |
| `a20_refuse_change` | BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE (per row) |  | `audit.refuse_change()` |
| `a20_refuse_truncate` | BEFORE TRUNCATE (per statement) |  | `audit.refuse_change()` |

**Row-level security policies**

| Policy | Command | USING | WITH CHECK |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entry_insert` | INSERT |  | `(NOT (tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM meta.current_tenant_id()))` |
| `entry_select` | SELECT | `((tenant_id = meta.current_tenant_id()) OR ((tenant_id IS NULL) AND (meta.current_tenant_id() IS NULL)))` |  |
